name: Boxing Legends Champion VR
summary:
Enter the ring and experience the intensity of boxing like never before in Boxing Legends Champion VR! Put on your gloves, face challenging opponents, and use your speed, power, and timing to dominate every fight.

Train your skills, throw powerful punches, block incoming attacks, dodge strikes, and look for the perfect moment to counter. Every fight tests your reflexes, accuracy, stamina, and ability to stay focused under pressure.

Feel the excitement of stepping into the ring as you battle your way towar
